basic_info.description: Enjoy vibrant city living in this modern 1-bedroom condo, ideally located in SF's cultural hub. Blocks from SFMOMA and the Yerba Buena Center for the Arts this home places you at the center of art, culture, and convenience. With the Transbay Terminal, BART, Muni, and highways nearby, commuting is seamless whether you're heading to work or exploring the Bay Area. Perched on the 10th floor of a luxury high-rise, the condo is bathed in morning light and sweeping views of the city skyline and Salesforce Park. The refreshed interior features new stone-core LVP flooring, plush carpet, fresh paint, and new balcony decking, creating a seamless indoor-outdoor flow between the open living area out to the private balcony. The thoughtfully designed layout offers space for living, dining, and a cozy office alcove, ideal for working from home. The kitchen is equipped with SS appliances, including a refrigerator, stovetop, oven, dishwasher, and microwave. Wake up to stunning city views from the bay windows in the bedroom and unwind in the spacious bathroom with a shower-over-tub. Additional highlights include in-unit washer and dryer, garage parking, lower HOA dues, and a well-managed building. Ideal starter home or pied--terre, this condo offers a perfect blend of comfort, style, and location.
